test_title: PYST 26: SSC CHSL - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 17 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: On decreasing the price of a fan by 30 percent, its sales increases by 40 percent. What will be the percentage decrease in its revenue?
solution:
Net percentage increase/decrease in revenue = ± x ± y ± xy/100

Net percentage increase/decrease in revenue 

⇒ - 30 + 40 – (30 × 40)/100 = 10 – 12 = -2%

∴ 2%
